bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  The Grill Room - a favourite of Oscar Wilde - this glamorous salon is a decadent experience. Held exclusively within this Grade II listed room, an Afternoon Tea experience at Hotel Café Royal is truly unique.  As gilded features decorate the mirrored room and artistic ceilings, delightful delicacies, sumptuous sweets, and overflowing Champagne and teas make the entire service one to remember. Plus, with live piano and an intimate setting, you will find yourself transported to a time gone by, one where patrons of old waltzed through the halls of this hallowed building.  Traditional afternoon tea is £79 per person or £90 per person with a glass of N.V. Veuve Clicquot Brut.  The historic Hotel Café Royal in the West End is home of award-winning Afternoon Tea on Regent Street. The grand hotel offers Londoners and visitors to the city the perfect spot for a special occasion or simply to indulge for an afternoon.
